body: Open-source vector similarity search for Postgres
plain_description: **Add fast similarity search to the Postgres data your business already stores.** Find nearby items with exact or approximate search, and combine vector queries with Postgres filters and full-text search.
technical_description: An open-source PostgreSQL extension for storing single-precision, half-precision, binary, and sparse vectors and querying nearest neighbors. Supports exact search and approximate search with HNSW and IVFFlat indexes, multiple distance metrics, binary quantization, and hybrid search with PostgreSQL full-text search. Works with any language that has a Postgres client.
title: pgvector
